content.text:
I reviewed the transcript, the key and the 13 record items, and paired them below.

**Summary of findings**

- 11 of 13 record items pair to key items; the record is accurate on every corrected figure ($48,210 not $84,000; $15,000/mo LTD not $50,000; age 58 not 60; $7,500 not $7,000; $1,000/mo per child).
- **Missed entirely (i6):** no item for Renata's note to Margit (CPA) warning of two Forms 8606 and two 1099-Rs, due this week (by Oct 16).
- **Wrong date (i3):** roll-in confirmation call is due Thursday Oct 15, 2026 (meeting was Tuesday Oct 13); record says Oct 16. The same bad date is echoed in item 11's conditional.
- **Coverage gaps:** item 4 records only Priya's $7,500 backdoor Roth leg — Declan's $7,500 nondeductible contribution and December conversion (after his IRA hits zero) are absent, so the $15,000 total is understated in effect. Item 11's e-sign packet likewise omits Declan's new traditional IRA.
- **Clean on parked/declined items:** none of the five NOT ACTIONS (457(b), cash balance plan, 529 superfunding, lake house, 100%/90-10 allocation) leaked into the action or account-action lists.
- **Padding:** item 3 (college funding "life event") and item 7 (Rowan/Ivy increase) restate the 529 action already captured in item 6; figures in both are accurate, but they are splits/restatements rather than independent content.

key_items.note: Captures partner effective July 1, 2026, K-1 income with quarterly estimates, buy-in from draws over two years, and move to the partners' profit-sharing 401(k). The added $24,500 each deferral figure matches the transcript. Life event, so owner/due n/a.

Saint Brennock/Aldmere affiliation-as-merger, Q1 2027 close, contract honored through June 2028, benefits harmonized. The extra $15,000/month group LTD cap is the corrected figure (Priya retracted $50,000), so figures are right. Life event, so owner/due n/a.

Wrenfield IRA rollover into the Coldharbor partners' 401(k) at $48,210, the corrected balance rather than the retracted $84,000. Does not restate the before-December-31, 2026 deadline that clears the pro-rata rule, but the figure is right and it is an account action, so owner/due n/a.

Only Priya's leg is recorded: new traditional IRA, $7,500 nondeductible, convert to Roth as soon as the account is open. $7,500 is the corrected 2026 figure (not $7,000), so no wrong figure, but Declan's matching $7,500 contribution and his December conversion once his IRA balance is zero are absent, so the $15,000 couple total is not reflected. Account action, so owner/due n/a.

Opens Callum's 529 with a $1,000/month automatic draft in an age-based portfolio. 'amount: NOT_FOUND' is an omission rather than a wrong figure. The three-child $3,000/month total and the November 1, 2026 first draft are not stated here; the Rowan/Ivy half is split off into item 7. Account action, so owner/due n/a.

Quotes from Pellwood Assurance and Ashgrove Life, owner Theo Brandvold, due end of October (Oct 31, 2026) - all final. Drops the 'true own-occupation, specialty-specific' qualifier and both insureds' names, but that is wording detail, not a figure, owner or date error.

Upload of the Saint Brennock group LTD certificate and benefits summary to the portal, owner Priya Halloran, due 2026-10-21 - the Wednesday date Priya moved it to, not the original Friday. No figures.

Owner correctly reassigned from Declan to Theo Brandvold and the task (confirm the plan accepts incoming IRA roll-ins, obtain the roll-in form) is right, but the due date is wrong: Theo promised an answer by Thursday, which is October 15, 2026 given the Tuesday October 13 meeting date; the record says 2026-10-16.

One e-sign packet, owner Theo Brandvold, due early next week (week of October 19, 2026) - the final due date is right. Two defects worth flagging: the packet list omits Declan's new traditional IRA (only Priya's is listed), and the parenthetical condition repeats the incorrect 2026-10-16 roll-in date instead of Thursday October 15.

Rerun at retirement age 58 - the corrected target, replacing 60 - plus updated 529 funding projections and sending the updated plan. Owner Renata Oakhurst, due before Thanksgiving (November 26, 2026). Does not spell out the 2043 year, but no figure is wrong.

Not captured anywhere in the record. Renata committed at 00:11:48 to send Margit, the couple's CPA, a note this week (by October 16, 2026) to expect two Forms 8606 and two 1099-Rs for the 2026 backdoor Roth conversions. No record item mentions Margit, Form 8606 or the 1099-Rs.

Request to Marisa Quennell, the practice administrator, for the Coldharbor partner group LTD certificate and the disability section of the partnership agreement. Owner Declan Halloran ('That one's mine'), due end of next week (October 23, 2026). No figures.

extra_items.note: Logged as a life event, but it is the 529 funding change already captured as account actions 6 and 7: 'current_contributions $500/month to Rowan and Ivy' and 'new_contributions $1,000/month to each child (including Callum)' restate those items. The balances it adds ($61,400 Rowan, $38,900 Ivy, Callum none) are accurate to the transcript at 00:22:24, so nothing here is wrong - it is a restatement rather than an independent life event.

Splits the single agreed 529 action (key a3) by carving the Rowan and Ivy increase from $500 to $1,000/month out of item 6. Figures are correct, but it is the other half of one action, not a separate one.
